column1: # The rename map: one row per name, read by apply.py (which refuses a fenced row) and by
# prove.py (which re-derives the code from the start commit with these rows applied). It holds
# the rows of one pull request; earlier rows are in Git and in their report.
# Striking a row and rerunning apply.py from the same base is the whole of undoing it.
# Columns, tab-separated: old, new, kind, the declaring file, the confusion removed, then the
# comment the row replaces -- its file, the comment lines before and after, `\n` between lines.
# The tests, build files and examples are renamed only where they declare the name: a name
# declared elsewhere, or used by a package, stays.
